description: Each sequence contributes one layer to the biome. Layers accrue in order. The biome at stage N = sum of layers 1..N. Before seq 8 the biome is NOT a nature biome — it is abstract mathematical forms floating in space, Kusama-like.

layer_kinds.floating_points: Sparse points in void. The Kusama field. Seq 1.
layer_kinds.floating_primitives: Seq 1. TWO faces by stage: at the primitives stage it renders a sparse GPU-particle sphere field (soft motes drifting in void); beneath any later sequence it renders the MultiMesh dot lattice that animated_primitives/color_tint/force_field/lattice_snap/wave_displace transform.
layer_kinds.animated_primitives: Existing primitives rotate, scale, translate. No new spawns. Seq 2.
layer_kinds.color_tint: Tints all existing layers by space position. No spawns. Seq 3.
layer_kinds.force_field: Primitives drift/collide under gravity or springs. No new spawns. Seq 4.
layer_kinds.lattice_snap: Floating primitives snap into regular grids/arrays. Seq 5.
layer_kinds.wave_displace: Position displaced by sin(kx - wt). No new spawns. Seq 6.
layer_kinds.jitter_seed: Random jitter + first proto-critters (random walkers). Seq 7.
layer_kinds.noise_dust: FIRST NOISE FIELD. Sparse floating DNA-carrying motes drift on a noise field — space dust critters will consume later. Not ground. Seq 8.
layer_kinds.ca_surface: Ground grows moss / tile patterns via Game-of-Life-like rule. First living patches. Seq 9.
layer_kinds.fractal_bloom: Recursive branching spawns where CA stable. Seq 10.
layer_kinds.adaptive_behavior: Critters adapt to the player. Seq 15.
layer_kinds.tunable_field: QFEP parameters as live sliders modulate all prior layers. Seq 17.
layer_kinds.critical_overlay: Bias visualizations overlay the living world. Seq 18.
layer_kinds.graph_connections: Edges drawn between related forms/creatures. Seq 19.
layer_kinds.biome_paint_dispatcher: Reads the map's biome_paint layer and spawns one substrate per painted cell. Curriculum-honest: each kingdom only renders past its unlock_order. Falls back to kingdom-coloured primitives when a substrate path isn't yet wired. Used by the biome_lab sequence (Biome_Spine, Biome_Zoo) and any future map that paints cells.

sequences.truth: in the primitives sequence, forms drift in the void as a sparse field of soft glowing spheres — presence-by-scarcity, not a counted lattice; beneath later sequences the same layer is the dot array those sequences bring to life
the primitives that exist begin to move — rotate, scale, translate — invariants revealed by motion
geometry acquires color — position becomes meaning in the spectrum
primitives push and pull each other — F=ma enters the void
primitives arrange into lattices — the grid emerges from swarm
position becomes a wave function — primitives ride standing waves
randomness enters — first proto-critters wander between the primitives
first noise — sparse motes of space dust carrying DNA drift on a noise field, waiting for critters to consume them
the ground remembers — CA rules grow moss patches, the first LIVING surface
where CA stabilizes, fractal forms bloom — self-similarity takes root
trees proper — grammar rewriting produces the recognizable tree form
creatures appear — DNA-driven, generated, distinct
flora gains squish — mushrooms wobble, flowers bend in wind
creatures flock — Reynolds' three rules produce collective life
creatures learn the player — they approach, retreat, remember
the biome shows its seams — Escher-like zones contradict themselves
the biome becomes tunable — λ and φ adjust every prior layer live
critical overlay — the bias of the system becomes visible on the living world
everything connects — edges drawn between related creatures and forms
the painted cell is a seed, not a render unit — every brush stroke becomes substrate at the right curriculum tier
